mechanism_narrative: The current federal funds rate of 0.38% is historically low, compressing discount rates and driving equity valuations upward, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of all trading days.

mechanism_narrative: When the CPI index falls below 238.5 (indicating below-target inflation), the Federal Reserve is likely to maintain or ease monetary policy, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL is below 238.5.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4.5% and real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) are above 440,000 million dollars, the economy is in a strong growth phase, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE < 4.5 and RSAFS > 440000.

mechanism_narrative: During a recession (as indicated by a quarterly decline in real GDP, GDPC1), the S&P 500 is likely to experience negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings and increased risk aversion.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 quarterly change < 0.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0%, it signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 105.0 (indicating a contraction in manufacturing), the S&P 500 is likely to experience negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate earnings and increased recession fears.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are above 1100.0 and industrial production (INDPRO) is below 105.0, the economy is in a state of weak demand and supply contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 50% of instances when HOUST > 1100.0 and INDPRO < 105.0.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate rises above 4.5%, it signals a tight monetary policy that increases discount rates and compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.5.
